title: 校园施工与承包商安全
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/146_校园施工与承包商安全.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/146_校园施工与承包商安全/src.py

points.S2: 承包商资质与安全协议

shots.scene: 欣欣戴着安全帽站在实验楼施工围挡前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wears a safety helmet and stands in front of a construction fence around a laboratory building, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第12章最后一课：校园施工与承包商安全。
overlay: 校园施工与承包商安全

shots.scene: 欣欣指着楼里正在装修的一层
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at one floor of the building where renovation work is going on behind the windows.
shots.narration: 楼里一边施工，一边还在做实验。

shots.scene: 实验楼二层在改造，工人在走廊钻孔
shots.prompt_en: Inside a laboratory building, a contractor worker drills into a corridor wall, dust spreading.
shots.narration: 实验楼改造，工人在走廊里钻孔。

shots.scene: 粉尘飘进隔壁开着门的实验室
shots.prompt_en: Dust drifts through an open door into the next laboratory where the female graduate student is weighing samples.
shots.narration: 粉尘飘进了隔壁的实验室。

shots.scene: 工人从实验室插座私接电线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a long extension cable running from a laboratory wall socket out to a construction tool in the corridor. No text.
shots.narration: 还从实验室插座私接了电线。

shots.scene: 老周找来王老师和施工负责人
shots.prompt_en: The older man calls the safety administrator and a contractor site manager to the corridor to talk.
shots.narration: 老周：施工前，为什么没人通知？

shots.scene: 施工现场四类致命伤害图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: four icons, a person falling, a falling object striking a head, a hand caught between machine parts and an electric shock. No text.
shots.narration: 施工四大致命伤害：坠落、打击、挤压、触电。

shots.scene: 坍塌、粉尘
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a collapsing wall section and a cloud of dust, each with a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 还有坍塌、粉尘和有害物质。

shots.scene: 化学品接触图标单独列出
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chemical drop icon placed beside the four fatal icons, labeled as also important. No text.
shots.narration: 接触危险物质，同样要防。

shots.scene: 进工地的人戴安全帽、穿安全鞋
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker entering a site gate wearing a safety helmet and safety boots, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 进施工区，人人戴安全帽、穿安全鞋。

shots.scene: 安全帽挡住落物，减轻碰撞
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helmet deflecting a falling bolt and protecting a head bumping into a beam. No text.
shots.narration: 安全帽挡落物，也减轻头部碰撞。

shots.scene: 【实拍】戴好安全帽，调紧帽衬，系好下颏带（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person puts on a safety helmet, tightens the headband and fastens the chin strap.
shots.narration: 帽衬调紧，下颏带系好。

shots.scene: 浇混凝土穿胶靴、戴手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker pouring wet concrete wearing rubber boots and gloves, a skin burn icon crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 湿混凝土碱性强，穿胶靴戴手套。

shots.scene: 涂料桶和安全技术说明书
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a paint can beside a blank safety data sheet, a magnifier on it. No text.
shots.narration: 刷涂料、用溶剂，先看安全技术说明书。

shots.scene: 附近禁止动火，保持通风
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a painting area with a no open flame sign, an open window and a fan blowing air out. No text.
shots.narration: 附近不动火，保持通风。

shots.scene: 桶下垫托盘，空桶及时清走
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a paint can standing in a spill tray, empty cans being carried away. No text.
shots.narration: 桶下垫托盘，不用的桶及时清走。

shots.scene: 戴防护手套和防毒口罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a painter wearing chemical gloves, goggles and a respirator. No text.
shots.narration: 戴好手套、护目镜和呼吸防护。

shots.scene: 喷砂作业：粉尘、噪声、振动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a sand blasting nozzle with dust, noise and vibration icons around it. No text.
shots.narration: 喷砂、钻孔、切割：粉尘、噪声、振动。

shots.scene: 设备破损伤人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worn blasting hose bursting, a warning icon. No text.
shots.narration: 设备损坏，也会伤人。

shots.scene: 施工方告知危害并发放防护用品
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a contractor supervisor handing out ear plugs and dust masks to workers with a blank hazard notice. No text.
shots.narration: 施工方要告知危害，发放防护用品。

shots.scene: 湿法作业、吸尘、封闭施工区
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a drill with water spray and a vacuum hood, the work area sealed with plastic sheeting. No text.
shots.narration: 湿法、吸尘、封闭，粉尘不进实验室。

shots.scene: 上下两层同时作业打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one worker on an upper level and another directly below at the same time, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 上下两层，不同时交叉作业。

shots.scene: 必须同时时设隔离棚，专人协调
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a protective canopy between two levels and a coordinator with a radio. No text.
shots.narration: 必须同时，设隔离防护，专人协调。

shots.scene: 地面盖板打开，四周围挡挂警示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor hatch opened in a lab building with barriers and a warning sign around it. No text.
shots.narration: 地面开口，四周围挡、挂警示。

shots.scene: 干完马上盖好
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the floor hatch closed and secured after work, a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 干完立即盖好，不留空洞。

shots.scene: 施工专用配电箱带漏电保护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lockable construction distribution box with a residual current device and a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 施工用电，从专用配电箱接。

shots.scene: 持证电工接线
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a qualified electrician with a blank operator certificate connecting a temporary cable. No text.
shots.narration: 临时用电，由持证电工安装。

shots.scene: 从实验室插座私拉电线打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cable pulled from a laboratory socket to a construction tool, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不从实验室插座私拉乱接。

shots.scene: 电缆不拖地泡水、架空或保护
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a temporary cable lying in a puddle crossed out, and a cable raised on hooks with a tick. No text.
shots.narration: 电缆不泡水、不被碾压。

shots.section_title: 承包商资质与安全协议
shots.scene: 承包商资质证书和安全协议
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank qualification certificate and a blank safety agreement signed by the university and a contractor. No text.
shots.narration: 承包商要有资质，签安全协议。
overlay: 承包商资质与安全协议

shots.section_title: 承包商资质与安全协议
shots.scene: 施工人员登记、培训后进场
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: contractor workers registering at a desk and attending a short safety training before entering. No text.
shots.narration: 施工人员登记、培训，再进场。

shots.section_title: 承包商资质与安全协议
shots.scene: 特种作业人员持证
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an electrician, a welder and a crane operator each holding a blank operator certificate card. No text.
shots.narration: 电工、焊工、起重工，持证上岗。

shots.section_title: 承包商资质与安全协议
shots.scene: 学校部门监督检查
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the facility engineer and the safety administrator inspecting a contractor site with a checklist. No text.
shots.narration: 学校统一协调，监督检查。

shots.scene: 安全员指导施工方守法规
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a site safety officer with a helmet pointing at a rule book and a work area. No text.
shots.narration: 安全员：指导施工方遵守法规。

shots.scene: 发现问题及时纠正
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the safety officer stopping a worker without a helmet and handing him one. No text.
shots.narration: 监督落实，发现问题及时纠正。

shots.scene: 班前安全交底
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a morning briefing of contractor workers at the site entrance before work. No text.
shots.narration: 开工前，组织班前安全交底。

shots.scene: 实验楼施工审批表盖章
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank renovation approval form receiving a stamp from the university office. No text.
shots.narration: 实验楼施工，先报审批。

shots.scene: 实验室负责人对本屋负责
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the older man standing at his lab door with a key, a responsibility icon above. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室负责人，对本屋负属地责任。

shots.scene: 动火另办审批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a welding torch icon and a separate blank hot work permit with a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 动火、高处、吊装，另按规定审批。

shots.scene: 【实拍】施工前把化学品移入试剂柜并贴施工告示（中景）
shots.prompt_en: Medium shot: a person moves reagent bottles from a bench into a cabinet, then sticks a blank notice on the lab door.
shots.narration: 开工前清场：化学品移走或隔离。

shots.scene: 气瓶、生物材料妥善处理
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: gas cylinders closed and secured, biological samples moved to a locked freezer. No text.
shots.narration: 气瓶、生物材料，也要妥善处理。

shots.scene: 设备去污后交给维修方确认
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lab member wiping an instrument for decontamination and handing a blank sign off sheet to a contractor. No text.
shots.narration: 设备先去污，交给维修方确认。

shots.scene: 排风机检修：通知停用通风柜，风管内壁有残留
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a worker on a roof wearing gloves and a respirator opening an exhaust duct, a fume hood below marked out of use. No text.
shots.narration: 修排风机，先停通风柜，防风管残留。

shots.scene: 边做实验边施工打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a researcher doing an experiment while a worker drills next to her, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 相关实验暂停，不边做边修。

shots.scene: 给相邻实验室发通知
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: notices posted on several lab doors along a corridor about upcoming works. No text.
shots.narration: 施工前，先告知相邻实验室。

shots.scene: 停水停电停气，提前安排
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student reads a shutdown notice and rearranges her experiment schedule.
shots.narration: 可能停水停电停气，提前安排实验。

shots.scene: 振动影响精密仪器
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: vibration waves from drilling reaching a precision balance and a microscope, a pause icon. No text.
shots.narration: 振动影响精密仪器，提前固定或暂停。

shots.scene: 作业区拉警戒、挂告示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a corridor work area with barriers and a blank notice, people kept outside. No text.
shots.narration: 作业区拉警戒，无关人员不进。

shots.scene: 学生不进围挡、不抄近路
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a student about to slip through a gap in a construction fence, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 围挡里面不要进，不抄近路穿工地。

shots.scene: 按标志绕行，远离吊装和车辆
shots.prompt_en: The young male student follows a detour sign around the construction site, keeping away from a crane and a truck.
shots.narration: 按标志绕行，远离吊装和车辆。

shots.scene: 发现围挡破损报告保卫处
shots.prompt_en: The young male student phones the campus security office about a broken section of the construction fence.
shots.narration: 发现围挡破损，告诉保卫处。

shots.scene: 安全帽、通风、警戒
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a safety helmet, a ventilation fan and a barrier. No text.
shots.narration: 施工现场：戴好防护，控制粉尘和用电。

shots.scene: 资质、协议、审批
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, a certificate, a signed agreement and a stamp. No text.
shots.narration: 承包商有资质、签协议，施工先审批。

shots.scene: 清场、告知、绕行
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, chemicals in a cabinet, a notice on a door and a detour arrow. No text.
shots.narration: 实验室先清场告知，学生绕行。

shots.scene: 第12章回顾：许可、动火、受限空间、高处、开挖、上锁、吊装图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a row of icons, a permit, a flame, a manhole, a harness, a trench, a padlock and a crane hook. No text.
shots.narration: 第12章：特种作业，先许可、后作业。

shots.scene: 欣欣坐在调好高度的实验座椅上挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot sits on an adjustable laboratory chair at a well arranged workbench and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：第13章，人机工效与工位设置。
